name: Nolan Kido
intro: I build and examine practical ways to use AI in everyday life and small-business work. I start with a real task, set boundaries, check the result, and keep important decisions with people. Explore free tools, recorded cases, and the limits that matter.
bio_short: Nolan Kido builds and examines practical AI workflows for everyday life and small-business work. His guiding principle is AI Works Human Decides: AI assists with defined tasks while people verify results and retain responsibility.
bio_long: Nolan Kido builds and examines practical ways to use AI in everyday life and small-business work. His guiding principle, AI Works Human Decides, keeps purpose, verification, permissions, and consequential choices with people. On his website he shares inspectable tools, recorded examples, and what they can and cannot establish. His other interests include Living Well, tournament poker, writing, and creative work.
